## pelican-server cache chaos truncate

Truncate a cached object's on-disk data

### Synopsis

Remove bytes from the end of one of a cached object's on-disk chunk files,
dropping trailing block(s). The cache detects the missing/short data on a cold
read or during the data scan.

By default the last chunk is truncated by one block; use --chunk and
--drop-bytes to control which chunk and how much is removed.

Examples:
  pelican cache chaos truncate pelican://my-federation/data/file.dat
  pelican cache chaos truncate /data/file.dat --drop-bytes 65536
  pelican cache chaos truncate --instance &lt;hash&gt; --chunk 0

```
pelican-server cache chaos truncate <object-url> [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --chunk int        Chunk index to truncate (default: the last chunk) (default -1)
      --drop-bytes int   Bytes to remove from the end of the chunk file (default: one block)
  -h, --help             help for truncate
```
